class_definitions.A_DEPLOYABLE: No symbol literal in trading logic (ea_symbol_literal_inventory.py: 0 trading_logic_literal / symbol_input_default findings for this EA's own registry symbol) and the registry symbol's base name is identical to the FTMO venue base name (no canonicalisation needed), or the EA is already live on the FTMO demo under this magic. Deployable today via the roster-driven trial_setpath + governor_rebind tooling from e0ba9fc32701; no code or registry change needed.
class_definitions.B_INPUT_DEFAULT: Symbol carried as a plain `input string strategy_..._symbol` (or matching `SYMBOL_INPUT_RE`) whose default is the .DWX factory name, with no hardcoded comparison gating trading logic. trial_setpath.rebind_symbol_inputs() (already in repo, part of e0ba9fc32701) rewrites this input to the venue name at preset-derivation time. Smallest fix: include the row in the roster passed to trial_setpath --roster; no source change, no rebuild, no Q02 re-entry.
class_definitions.C_ALIAS_GAP: EA carries no symbol literal, but its registry symbol is an index whose FTMO venue base name differs from the registry base name (US100.cash vs NDX, US30.cash vs WS30, GER40.cash vs GDAXI), so the universal init-time guard `QM_MagicChecked(...,_Symbol)` -> `QM_MagicSymbolCanonical()` (framework/include/QM/QM_MagicResolver.mqh, called from QM_Common.mqh:273 in every EA's OnInit) fails closed unless that base pair has an explicit alias AND the binary was rebuilt after the alias was added. Smallest fix: add the missing base-pair alias to QM_MagicSymbolCanonical() (ROT-class, OWNER-only registry/identity decision per Hard Rules and the 2026-09-15 census) and recompile the affected EA(s); no source logic change and no new Q02 identity, because the alias lives in a shared header, not in the EA.
class_definitions.D_SOURCE_LITERAL: EA hardcodes an exact string comparison against a `.DWX` factory symbol name inside its trading-logic gate (`Strategy_NoTradeFilter`, `Strategy_ExpectedSlot`, `Strategy_IsHostChart`, `Strategy_IsXtiD1`, etc.), independent of the resolver guard. On the FTMO venue name the comparison is always false, so the gate returns 'no trade' forever: INIT_OK, zero orders, no error. Smallest fix per company policy: rebuild the EA against the OWNER 2026-09-06 symbol-as-input rule (symbol becomes an input, resolver compares base names via QM_MagicSymbolCanonical). This produces a new binary identity that must re-enter the pipeline at Q02 (2026-09-15 census correction (ii)); it cannot be admitted to the FTMO book as a precondition. Cheapest deployment-only alternative: drop or substitute the sleeve in the roster (OWNER roster decision, not a code fix).
